items.title: John Pope Interview, 1959-05-01
items.q: The interviewee describes a piano player but does not name him. The interviewer identifies the person as Edward Wright. The interviewee does not confirm or deny knowing Edward Wright, nor does he claim to have played with him.

ctx.x: Well we played with the piano most of the time. Always had a piano playing. In fact, I had one of the best piano players I believe... well... I don't know what he... he composed some music and he was an arranger for some concern in Chicago.

American Conservancy. Who's that? American Conservancy. Oh the American... I was in Chicago. I knew that. Edward Wright. Edward Wright. Yeah, he was Edward Wright. He's still there. He's in a cast now. Edward Wright. Uh-huh. Edward Wright. He's very interested to talk to him. He's in a cast. He was run old for years... about a couple of years ago.
Oh, I understand. Edward Wright. Yeah. I was going to ask... did you know Cootie Williams? Yes, Cootie played with me quite a bit.
